targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS "Avg CSAT"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND overall_score IS NOT NULL
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Responses"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN resolved = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS "Resolved %"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN would_return = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS "Would return %"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(staff_name), ''), staff_user_id) AS staff,
  COUNT(DISTINCT feedback_id) AS responses,
  ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN resolved = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS resolved_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN speed_rating = 'fast' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS fast_rate
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    feedback_id,
    staff_user_id,
    staff_name,
    overall_score,
    speed_rating,
    resolved,
    would_return,
    created_at,
    ticket_type,
    server
  FROM grafana_ticket_feedback_staff
) s
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND staff_user_id IN ($staff)
GROUP BY staff_user_id
ORDER BY avg_score DESC, responses DESC

SELECT
  $__unixEpochGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
  ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND overall_score IS NOT NULL
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  FROM_UNIXTIME(created_at) AS submitted_at,
  ticket_id,
  ticket_type,
  server,
  overall_score,
  speed_rating,
  resolved,
  would_return,
  closer_user,
  claimer_user,
  first_responder_user
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  FROM_UNIXTIME(created_at) AS submitted_at,
  ticket_id,
  ticket_type,
  server,
  overall_score,
  closer_user,
  claimer_user,
  first_responder_user,
  comment
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND comment IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(comment) != ''
  AND ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    closer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR claimer_user_id IN ($staff)
    OR first_responder_user_id IN ($staff)
  )
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200
